notes: All 246 species accepted by Kew's Plants of the World Online (fetched 2026-09-26). 'genus_grammar' gives the shared petiole/leaf/spathe rules and ranges; species without an 'appearance' block are painted by the engine from the grammar, seeded by species name so each is stable.

genus_grammar.what: Shared rules for painting any Amorphophallus, plus ranges to vary within for undocumented species. Built from the 34 documented entries below.

plant.habit: single leaf per season on one tall petiole; no stem/trunk; petiole ends in a 3-branched umbrella of dissected leaflets; inflorescence rises separately from the bare tuber (usually before the leaf, rarely with it)

petiole.base_note: greens dominate (pale green to blackish olive); 20% lean brown/reddish-brown; 5% have a whitish-pink ground almost hidden under green blotches (konjac type)
petiole.marking_note: two-layer rule: large elongate/oval blotches (pale on dark ground, or dark on pale ground) plus a fine scatter of tiny dots of the opposite value; blotches often confluent and elongated along the petiole axis
petiole.base_zone: lowest 10-20% of petiole often shifts to pink/reddish/grey or whitish, then grades to the main colour
petiole.lichen_note: lichen: the designer's archetype (2026-09-28) — large irregular pale grey-green to whitish blotches with ragged, slightly darker rims on a dark olive or blackish ground, plus the fine dark-dot scatter; reads exactly like crustose lichen on bark. Blotches confluent at the base, breaking into islands up the petiole. Each tuber rolls its own blotch layout within the species' ranges.

spathe.outer_markings: whitish or blackish-green spots on the tube base (60%); margin often a contrasting line (purple, red-violet or brown) (50%); frilled/undulate limb margin in 40%
spathe.inner_rule: base of tube inside is nearly always dark maroon/purple and warty (verrucose); limb inside is either the same dark colour (glossy) or a pale cream/greenish/pink zone; a two-tone dark-base/pale-limb split is the commonest
spathe.shape: funnel/campanulate tube with a flaring limb; limb 1-3x tube length

spadix.form: appendix longer than spathe in 60% (conical/whip); subglobose brain-like in 10%; mouse-tail thread in 5%; surface smooth 60%, wrinkled/warty 35%, hairy 5%

fruit.form: cylinder of tightly packed berries on the old spadix, red/orange ones ripening top-down

genus_grammar.seasonal: leaf and inflorescence never overlap except in coaetaneus/ongsakulii; plant vanishes entirely into the tuber for the dormant season

_help_region: region: the catalogue region (regions table) each species belongs to, from its source text or nearest band; realm: the biogeographic realm used as the continent gate (design: species spawn only in biome associations tagged with the same realm, or untagged ones). needs dry_ground: tubers rot in swamp and marsh.
